BehaviorTree.ID: Calibrate Scene Camera From Tote Board
BehaviorTree._description: Runs stage d.1 (Calibrate Wrist Camera On Tote Board) and then stage d.2: places the original scene D415 from the tote board pose that stage d.1 just saved, since the scene camera sees the same board. Saves the scene_camera_link section of cell_calibration.yaml, then runs Load Calibrated Scene, which places the tote and publishes world to scene_camera_link. The tote and the tote board must not have moved since stage d.1. See design_docs/board_based_calibration.md.
